_note: Hand-authored fixture (not a model recording). See scripts/author_fixtures.py.

responses.summary: CR2032-powered BLE asset tag with wake-on-motion accelerometer.
functional_goals: wake on motion from an accelerometer interrupt
SWD programming through a Tag-Connect footprint

power_sources.notes: CR2032: about 3 mA continuous, 15 mA pulse

responses.duty_cycle: BLE advertising once per second, about 3 ms radio-on per event

assumptions.text: Advertising interval 1 s with ~3 ms active per event
Single-sided assembly with the coin holder on top: 40 x 30 mm. Moving the holder to the bottom side could shrink the board to about 30 x 25 mm.
LED is used only briefly; excluded from the average current
Runs directly from the coin cell, no regulator (nRF52 accepts 1.7-3.6 V)

open_questions: Advertising payload and interval required by the asset system?
